english.note: Use this when someone is anxious or eager to start or get something.
Use this when the eagerness includes impatience or urgency, as in not being able to wait.
Use this when the person is impatient or eager to act rather than willing to wait.
Use this when anxious means eager or impatient to do or find out something.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 gap1 soeng2 faai3 di1 hoi1 ci2

examples.english: I’m eager to know the result and can’t wait.
examples.traditional: 我心急，等唔切想知個結果。

examples.traditional: 唔好咁心急，等埋大家先開始啦。
